import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# attempt to import seaborn, install if missing
import subprocess, sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])
try:
    import seaborn as sns
except ImportError:
    install('seaborn')
    import seaborn as sns

# Load datasets
df_succ = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
df_unsucc = pd.read_parquet('train_neg.parquet')

# Drop rows with null SA_delta or target_delta
succ = df_succ[['SA_delta', 'target_delta']].dropna()
unsucc = df_unsucc[['SA_delta', 'target_delta']].dropna()

# Compute correlations
n1 = len(succ); n2 = len(unsucc)
r1, p1 = stats.pearsonr(succ.SA_delta, succ.target_delta)
r2, p2 = stats.pearsonr(unsucc.SA_delta, unsucc.target_delta)
rho1, sp1 = stats.spearmanr(succ.SA_delta, succ.target_delta)
rho2, sp2 = stats.spearmanr(unsucc.SA_delta, unsucc.target_delta)

# Fisher Z-test for difference in Pearson r
z1, z2 = np.arctanh(r1), np.arctanh(r2)
se = np.sqrt(1/(n1-3) + 1/(n2-3))
z_stat = (z1 - z2) / se
p_diff = 2 * (1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(z_stat)))

# Summary table
summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'n': [n1, n2],
    'Pearson_r': [r1, r2],
    'Pearson_p': [p1, p2],
    'Spearman_rho': [rho1, rho2],
    'Spearman_p': [sp1, sp2]
}, index=['Successful', 'Unsuccessful'])
print("Correlation summary:")
print(summary.round(4))
print(f"\nFisher Z-test comparing Pearson r: z={z_stat:.3f}, p={p_diff:.2e}\n")

# Scatterplots with regression lines
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5), sharex=True, sharey=True)
for ax, data, title, r, p in [
    (axes[0], succ, 'Successful edits', r1, p1),
    (axes[1], unsucc, 'Unsuccessful edits', r2, p2)
]:
    sns.regplot(x='SA_delta', y='target_delta', data=data,
                scatter_kws={'s':10, 'alpha':0.3}, line_kws={'color':'red'}, ax=ax)
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xlabel('SA_delta')
    ax.set_ylabel('target_delta')
    ax.text(0.05, 0.95, f"r={r:.3f}, p={p:.2e}", ha='left', va='top', transform=ax.transAxes)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
